lines.en: label kirinspring4:
scene kirinmallsad1

{size=-2}With the looming threat of another beach trip suddenly on the horizon for your hero (me), I have been kidnapped by a rich girl so that she can model swimsuits just to not buy any of them despite all of the money she has.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}由于又要去海滩的威胁突然出现在你的英雄（也就是我）的地平线上，我被一个有钱的女孩绑架了，就为了让她试穿泳衣——然后一件也不买，尽管她有的是钱。{/size}

lines.en: {size=-2}This part has already happened, though. So you unfortunately don’t get to experience everything I just did, which may or may not also include ejaculating so deeply inside of her that I think I may have fertilized her heart.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}不过这部分已经发生过了。所以很遗憾，你没办法体验我刚刚经历的一切，而在那一切之中，可能包含、也可能不包含我把她射得那么深，以至于我怀疑自己给她的心脏授了精。{/size}

lines.en: Now, if anyone else would like to step forward and allow me to have sex with them in the dressing room of this store, please do so. For I believe I may have unintentionally started another collection just now.
lines.zh: 现在，如果还有谁愿意站出来，让我在这家店的更衣室里和她做爱，请尽管上前。因为我觉得我刚才可能无意间又开了一个新系列。

lines.en: : Well, that was fun.
lines.zh: : 嗯，挺好玩的。

lines.en: : You never intended to actually buy a new swimsuit today, did you?
lines.zh: : 你今天从一开始就没打算真的买新泳衣，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad2
: Sometimes, a girl just needs a little mild exhibitionism to get back on track. And what better place for such a thing than a dressing room at the local mall?
lines.zh: : 有时候，一个女孩只需要一点点温和的暴露癖就能重回正轨。而有什么地方比本地商场的更衣室更适合干这种事呢？

lines.en: : A parade.
lines.zh: : 一场游行。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad3
: I said “mild” exhibitionism. I’m not ready for an entire parade to hear me getting pounded by my future husband yet.
lines.zh: : 我说了是“温和的”暴露癖。我还没准备好让一整场游行都听见我被未来的老公干。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re ready for any amount of people hearing you {i}at all{/i} when getting caught by a single classmate traumatized you so badly.
lines.zh: : 你连被一个同学撞见都留下了那么大的心理阴影，我真惊讶你居然能接受被任何人{i}听见{/i}。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad4
: Hey, I was still new to sex when Kirin decided to violate us. I’m such a pro now that, if it happened today, I’d probably only cry a little bit.
lines.zh: : 喂，Kirin 决定侵犯我们的时候，我在性事上还是个新手。现在我可是老手了，要是今天再发生一次，我大概只会哭一小会儿。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. Because chances are, it will eventually happen again. And also, Kirin is here right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那挺好。因为这种事迟早会再发生的。而且，Kirin 现在就在这儿。

lines.en: : Mhm. Sure she is. Try to distract me all you want, Akira. I’m still going to ask you why the girls working here said “not again” the second we walked into the sex closet together.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。她当然在。你想怎么转移我注意力都行，Akira。我还是要问你，为什么我们俩一起走进那个性爱小隔间的时候，这里的店员说了句“别又来”。

lines.en: : It’s still a dressing room even if I have only ever used it for sex. Also, I’m not lying. Look.
lines.zh: : 哪怕我只用它来做爱，它也还是更衣室。还有，我没撒谎。你看。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad5
: Fine. Where is- oh. Yup. That’s her. I can see the desire to wreck various homes from all the way over here.
lines.zh: : 行吧。人在哪——哦。啊，是她。我从这么远都能看见她想把各个家拆了的欲望。

lines.en: : She looks sad.
lines.zh: : 她看起来很伤心。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Let’s go talk to her.
lines.zh: : 去跟她说说话。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad6

: No. In fact, let’s go back inside the sex closet right now. Before your desire to please every cute teenage girl in the world compels you to force me into an awkward situation instead of just up against a wall.
lines.zh: : 不要。事实上，我们现在就回那个性爱小隔间里去。免得你想讨好全世界每一个可爱少女的欲望，逼着把我按在尴尬的处境里，而不是按在墙上。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad7
: Hi, Kirin. How can I make your life worse today?
lines.zh: : 嗨，Kirin。今天我能怎么让你的生活更糟一点？

lines.en: : Oh, come on! She’d find us anyway if you {i}didn’t{/i} go walking up to her and at least {i}then{/i} I’d have a penis inside of me to numb the pain!
lines.zh: : 哦拜托！就算你{i}不{/i}过去搭话她也照样会找到我们的，而至少{i}那样{/i}我体内还有根阴茎能替我止痛！

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad8
: Oh. Uhh...hey. What are...you guys doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……嗨。你们……在这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : “Shopping.”
: Why did you say it like that?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛用那种语气说？

lines.en: : Because we weren’t actually shopping. We were exercising our insatiable love for one another in the same dressing room you’re about to go be a lonely whore in.
lines.zh: : 因为我们其实没在逛街。我们是在你马上要进去当个孤独妓女的那个更衣室里，操练我们彼此之间贪得无厌的爱。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad9
: And “hello” to you too, Ayane. I like your outfit.
lines.zh: : 也跟你问声好，Ayane。我喜欢你这身。

lines.en: : Don’t be nice to me. It makes it harder to hate you.
lines.zh: : 别对我这么好。这会让我更难恨你。

lines.en: : Are you looking for a new swimsuit too? I don’t normally see you out by yourself these days.
lines.zh: : 你也在找新泳衣吗？最近我都不怎么看到你一个人出门了。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad10
: You don’t normally see me at all these days...and yeah. I’ve had the old one for a while, so...I thought maybe buying something might make me feel a little better.
lines.zh: : 最近你根本就不怎么看到我……嗯，是啊。旧的我已经穿了很久了，所以……我想也许买件新的能让我好受一点。

lines.en: : What happened?
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了？

lines.en: : Don’t fall for her tricks. She’s only pretending to have feelings so you’ll take {i}her{/i} into the sex closet next.
lines.zh: : 别上{i}她{/i}的当。她只是装作有感情，好让你下回带她进那个性爱小隔间。

lines.en: : Ayane, relax. She hasn’t even-
lines.zh: : Ayane，放松点。她还没——

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad11
: No, it’s fine. I...get it.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系。我……懂的。

lines.en: : I’d...never forgive someone either if they...did what I did to you guys. She can insult me all she wants and that’s...I get it.
lines.zh: : 如果有人对我做了我对你们做过的那些事，我也……绝对不会原谅她。她想怎么侮辱我都行，那……我懂的。

lines.en: : I really just...{i}get it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是真的……{i}懂的{/i}。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad12
: Why not come hang out with us?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不跟我们一起逛？

lines.en: : What?...
: Yeah. {i}What?{/i}
: What? She pretty clearly doesn’t want to be alone right now. Just look at the way she’s timidly holding her arm and looking up at me with puppy dog eyes.
lines.zh: : 什么？她现在明摆着不想一个人待着。你看看她怯生生地抱着胳膊、用小狗一样的眼神抬头看我的样子。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad13
: I don’t care how cute she looks. She sexually assaulted me and never even showed any remorse until I threatened to beat her to a pulp after school one day.
lines.zh: : 我才不管她看起来多可爱。她性侵了我，而且从来没有表现出哪怕一点点悔意，直到有一天放学后我威胁说要把她打成肉酱。

lines.en: : Sorry, you did what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你干了什么？

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad14
: Nothing. I’m the good one.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我是乖的那个。

lines.en: : Ayane’s right, Sensei. It’s definitely...weird to invite me along when you guys are out on a date and stuff...
lines.zh: : Ayane 说得对，老师。你们俩约会的时候叫上我，确实……挺奇怪的……

lines.en: : I’ll just...find another store and...grab something, then go home. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 我就……去别的店……随便买点，然后回家吧。不过还是谢谢你们。

lines.en: : There! Done and dusted. I’m glad we were able to reach a resolution everyone is okay with.
lines.zh: : 好了！搞定收工。很高兴我们能达成一个大家都能接受的结论。

lines.en: : How about lunch?
lines.zh: : 去吃午饭怎么样？

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad15
: Darling, are you perhaps confusing me with one of the other six hundred girls you are sleeping with? Because it seems to me like you suddenly think I have a humiliation kink or something!
lines.zh: : 亲爱的，你该不会是把我跟你睡过的那六百个女孩里的某一个搞混了吧？因为在我看来，你好像突然觉得我有被羞辱癖之类的！

lines.en: : I...really shouldn’t if Ayane is so opposed. I don’t want to intrude.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ayane 这么反对的话，我……真的不该去。我不想打扰你们。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad16
: Again, stop being nice. I know you’re only doing it to sabotage my date.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，别对我这么好。我知道你这么做只是为了搅黄我的约会。

lines.en: : I’m literally trying to leave and he won’t let me.
lines.zh: : 我明明在努力离开，是他不让我走。

lines.en: : Walk. You have legs. And this may come as a surprise, but they are good for more than just spreading.
lines.zh: : 走啊。你有腿的。也许说出来你会惊讶，但腿除了张开之外还有别的用处。

lines.en: : Despite how rare it is and how attractive I find this abrasive side of Ayane, I can’t help but feel like inviting Kirin along is still the right thing to do.
lines.zh: : 尽管 Ayane 这一面很少见，而且我觉得她这副扎人的样子相当迷人，我还是忍不住觉得，叫上 Kirin 一起仍然是对的事。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad17

: Now {i}you’re{/i} confusing me too! Peppering things I don’t {i}want{/i} to hear with things I {i}do{/i} want to hear is like putting rainbow sprinkles on mashed potatoes! You can’t trick me into thinking it’s ice cream!
lines.zh: : 现在{i}你{/i}把我也搞糊涂了！在我不{i}想{/i}听的话里掺上我{i}想{/i}听的话，就像在土豆泥上撒彩虹糖针一样！你别想骗我说那是冰淇淋！

lines.en: : It’s just for a little while, Ayane. Do this and I’ll say yes to everything for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 就一会儿，Ayane。答应这个，剩下的这一天我什么都答应你。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad18
: E...Everything?
lines.zh: : 所……所有事？

lines.en: : I should go.
lines.zh: : 我该走了。

lines.en: : Wait. There’s a real chance I may be able to stop hating you for thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 等等。这次我真的有可能做到有三十分钟不恨你。

lines.en: : No, really. I...I mean, {i}I{/i} feel kind of weird right now anyway. You’re enjoying yourselves on your day off and I was just...an unfortunate coincidence you encountered along the way.
lines.zh: : 不，真的。{i}我{/i}……我是说，我现在本来就感觉有点怪。你们休息日在好好玩，而我只是……你们路上碰到的一个不幸的巧合。

lines.en: : Every day is my day off. I’m a professional slacker who mooches off the system and has somehow, almost miraculously, not been caught yet.
lines.zh: : 我每天都在休息日。我是一个专业的混子，靠制度吃白食，而且不知怎么奇迹般地到现在都没被抓包。

lines.en: : I meant Ayane. I already knew that about you. And...yeah. It would be nice to...have {i}something{/i} to do today. But without her blessing, I-
lines.zh: : 我是说 Ayane。你那些我早就知道了。而且……嗯。今天要是能……{i}有点事{/i}做也挺好的。但没有她的允许，我——

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad19
: Oh my f- fine. You can have lunch with us. But {i}only{/i} because I want to do some really weird stuff with Sensei and you look legitimately pathetic right now.
lines.zh: : 哦我天——行吧。你可以和我们一起吃午饭。但{i}只{/i}是因为我今天想和老师做点特别奇怪的事，而你现在看起来确实挺可怜的。

lines.en: : You really do. And, unlike Ayane, I mean that in the least mean way possible.
lines.zh: : 你确实挺可怜的。而且和 Ayane 不一样，我说这话的时候已经是尽量不刻薄了。

lines.en: : Do I...really look that bad? I actually felt kind of cute today...
lines.zh: : 我……真的看起来那么糟吗？我今天其实觉得自己还挺可爱的……

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad20

: It’s a vibe thing, right? Like, aesthetically, you look the same as always. But it’s like the rabid cat living inside of you has turned into a frightened rabbit for reasons I can only assume are stupid and immature in nature.
lines.zh: : 这是气场问题，对吧？就是，光看外表你跟平时一模一样。但就像住在你体内那只疯猫，因为一些我只能假设是又蠢又幼稚的原因，变成了一只受惊的兔子。

lines.en: : I agree that it’s a “vibe thing.” And if something’s wrong, Kirin, you can tell us.
lines.zh: : 我同意这是“气场问题”。而且 Kirin，如果有什么不对劲，你可以跟我们说。

lines.en: : No, she can tell you. In private. When I am no longer around. The last thing I want is to feel bad for this human.
lines.zh: : 不，她可以跟你说。私下说。等我不在的时候。我最不需要的就是开始同情这个人。

lines.en: : I’m really lonely.
lines.zh: : 我真的很孤独。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad21
: Oh, {i}great.{/i} Here we go.
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}好极了{/i}。来了。

lines.en: : {size=-2}And it’s all my fault...All this time, I’ve been pretending to be something I’m not. Chasing after some elusive form of self-actualization by degrading myself so brutally and repeatedly. It’s as if I’m caught in a cycle of-{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}而且全是我的错……一直以来，我都在假装成不是我自己的样子。用如此残忍而反复地贬低自己，去追逐某种难以捉摸的自我实现。就好像我被困在了一个——{/size}

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad22
: No one cares! Let’s get lunch!
lines.zh: : 没人关心！去吃午饭！

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad23
: {i}Come on, future husband! And you too, future dog! A new restaurant just opened up on the second floor!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}走吧，未来的老公！还有你，未来的狗！二楼新开了家餐厅！{/i}

lines.en: : Sorry about her. A lot has changed since you two stopped talking.
lines.zh: : 替她抱歉一下。你们俩不说话之后，变了很多。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like it isn’t my fault.
lines.zh: : 我是说，这也不是不是我的错。

lines.en: : Which is...I mean, pretty much {i}everything{/i} that’s happened to me is my fault. But even so, I can’t...help but be sad about it. Why {i}am{/i} I sad about it? Why do I have so many {i}feelings{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 也就是说……我是说，发生在我身上的事基本都是我的错。但即便如此，我还是忍不住……会难过。我为什么会难过？我为什么现在有这么多{i}感情{/i}？

lines.en: : Well, you’re in love with someone now. That changes things.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你现在爱上一个人了。那会改变很多事。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad24
: Wha...pshssshhh...abaaha...{i}Ayane’s right there!{/i}
lines.zh: : 什……嘶嘶嘶……啊啊啊……{i}Ayane 就在旁边啊{/i}！

lines.en: : And you’re right here. With me. Which is exactly where you want to be. So why pretend you should be going somewhere else right now?
lines.zh: : 而你就在这儿。在我身边。这正是你想待的地方。那又何必装作你现在该去别的地方呢？

lines.en: : {i}Because that’s all I ever do!{/i} I haven’t figured out how to be someone worth loving yet!
lines.zh: : {i}因为我一直只会做这一件事{/i}！我还没学会怎么做一个值得被爱的人！

lines.en: : I’d say look at Ayane and get some pointers from her, but she is particularly spicy today.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想说你看看 Ayane、跟她取取经，但她今天可是特别泼辣。

lines.en: : {i}What the heck does she even want to do with you that convinced her it’s okay to bring me along?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她到底想跟你干什么，才让她觉得把我带上也没关系啊？！{/i}

lines.en: : To be honest, I don’t know. And the only reason I do not look terrified right now is because I’m an expert at hiding my emotions.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不知道。而我现在之所以看上去没有被吓到，唯一的原因就是我是个隐藏情绪的专家。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem! Akira? Actual teenage girl over here. Don’t you want to give into temptation and follow me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}咳咳！Akira？这里有个货真价实的少女哦。你不想屈服于诱惑、跟我来吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad25
: Sensei...I...
: Something happened during...Christmallowen that I...
lines.zh: : 圣诞万圣节那天发生了一些事，我……

lines.en: : I can’t...I don’t...I-
lines.zh: : 我说不出口……我不知道……我——

lines.en: : {i}Hi, security? That girl over there is harassing my husband and I’d like to file a complaint.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}喂，保安吗？那边那个女孩在骚扰我丈夫，我想投诉。{/i}

lines.en: : Hold that thought, Kirin. I need to go tell someone {i}else{/i} I’m not married to a teenager today.
lines.zh: : 这个话题先放着，Kirin。我得去跟{i}别人{/i}说说我今天没跟未成年结婚。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad26
Ayane settles down after a few more minutes and goes back to normal...ish.
lines.zh: 又过了几分钟，Ayane 冷静下来，恢复了正常……大概吧。

lines.en: I guess it’s more just resigning herself to the fact that Kirin is present rather than actually accepting her, though. Which is probably what she does in school as well, just I’m never around to actually see it anymore.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得那与其说是真的接受了 Kirin，不如说只是认命了她就在这儿这件事。她在学校里大概也是这样，只是我再也不在旁边，所以看不到而已。

lines.en: : Say aaaaaaahh...Akiraaaaa...{i}aaaaaaaahhh...{/i}my twenty four hours of yeses begins noooow........
lines.zh: : 来，啊{i}啊啊啊{/i}……Akiraaaaa……啊啊啊……我的二十四小时全答应开始喽……

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad27
Kirin, on the other hand, could not be any more different from normal if she tried. But that’s why I felt so inclined to call out to her in the first place, even knowing it would upset Ayane.
lines.zh: 而 Kirin 呢，就算她想装得正常一点，也不可能和平时有更大的差别了。但正因为如此，我才这么想叫住她，哪怕我知道那会让 Ayane 不高兴。

lines.en: Which I guess might be the wrong move from a moral standpoint. I mean, I’m sure if you explained this exchange to someone on paper that I’d look like a real asshole right now.
lines.zh: 从道德角度看，我猜这可能是步错棋。我是说，要是把这段对话摊在纸上给别人看，我大概会显得像个彻头彻尾的混蛋。

lines.en: But despite her mistakes and despite what she’s done, I can’t help but look at Kirin like a real person with real feelings rather than a monster.
lines.zh: 但尽管她犯过错、做过那些事，我还是忍不住把 Kirin 看成一个有真实感情的真人，而不是一个怪物。

lines.en: If only mirrors felt the same.
lines.zh: 要是镜子也这么想就好了。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just projection. Maybe it’s love. Maybe I {i}do{/i} want to drag her into a dressing room next? Whatever it is, I don’t think it really matters.
lines.zh: 也许这只是投射。也许是爱。也许我{i}确实{/i}想下一个把她拖进更衣室？不管是什么，我觉得都不重要。

lines.en: All that happened was I saw someone who didn’t want to be alone and invited them along, regardless of the consequences that doing such a thing may bring.
lines.zh: 事情的全部不过是：我看到一个人不想一个人待着，就叫上了她，不管这么做会带来什么后果。

lines.en: It is this exact recklessness that has created the world I’ve made for myself. And I’m sure that Kirin’s would look similar right now if I could only see the world through her eyes.
lines.zh: 正是这种不计后果，造就了我给自己造出来的这个世界。而我敢肯定，如果我能透过 Kirin 的眼睛看世界，她的世界现在也会是差不多的样子。

lines.en: I don’t think I’d want to, though.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得我并不想看。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad28
I don’t think this would be easy.
lines.zh: 我觉得这不会容易。

lines.en: In fact, I think the sight before her right now isn’t all that dissimilar from a failed attempt at arson.
lines.zh: 事实上，我觉得此刻呈现在她眼前的景象，和一次失败的纵火尝试没什么两样。

lines.en: She tried to burn this down once. Or at least that’s how {i}that{/i} looks on paper too. Until that paper bursts into flames, at least.
lines.zh: 她曾经试图把这把火烧掉。或者说，至少纸面上看起来是这么回事。至少在{i}那{/i}张纸自己烧起来之前。

lines.en: It was never an appetite for destruction that compelled her to “attack” us on the beach so long ago, though.
lines.zh: 不过，当初驱使她在海滩上“攻击”我们的，从来就不是什么破坏欲。

lines.en: And I imagine, in hindsight, that if I were to pin her down in that moment and tell her she is loved, she’d be someone completely different from who she wound up as today.
lines.zh: 而我在想，如果能回到那一刻，把她按住、告诉她她是被人爱着的，她会变成一个和今天完全不同的人。

lines.en: My life is full of small regrets like that. So is hers. And there are so many things the two of us would change if we only had foresight. But a great deal of what life {i}is{/i} is accepting you don’t.
lines.zh: 我的人生满是这种小小的遗憾。她也是。如果有先见之明，我们俩有太多事会去改变。但人生很大一部分，{i}就是{/i}接受你没有先见之明。

lines.en: And that, sometimes, you are going to make decisions that make every {i}subsequent{/i} decision ten times harder.
lines.zh: 以及，有时候你会做出一些决定，让{i}之后{/i}的每一个决定都难上十倍。

lines.en: {size=-5}Then one day, you’ll be at a clothing store somewhere, staring at someone you care about who hasn’t responded to any of your messages today, wondering where you went wrong. Then having too many failures to choose from in actually wondering that.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}然后有一天，你会站在某家服装店里，盯着一个你在乎、却一整天都没回你消息的人，想知道自己到底哪里做错了。然后在真要去想这个问题的时候，却又发现有太多失败可供挑选。{/size}

lines.en: This is something I haven’t felt myself because {i}I{/i} am lucky.
lines.zh: 这种感觉{i}我自己{/i}没体会过，因为我很幸运。

lines.en: Not everyone is, though. And I often try to remember that in between unwanted blessings.
lines.zh: 但不是每个人都幸运。而在那些不想要的恩赐之间，我常常试着记住这一点。

lines.en: But I often fail.
lines.zh: 但我常常做不到。

lines.en: As it turns out, blessings are more appealing than regrets, even when undeserved. And that I’d rather live a life of lies than one where I must face the facts I have written myself.
lines.zh: 事实证明，恩赐比遗憾更有吸引力，哪怕那恩赐并不配得。而我宁愿活在谎言里，也不愿活在必须面对自己亲手写下的事实的人生里。

lines.en: If life is what you make it, just make it better. Lock the sad parts away.
lines.zh: 如果人生是你自己塑造的，那就把它塑得好一点。把悲伤的部分锁起来。

lines.en: Just accept that, in doing so, there will be moments where they attempt to break free and send your life spiraling into a colossal tempest of unrealized ambition and mind-shattering anguish.
lines.zh: 只是要接受：这么做的话，总会有那么一些时刻，它们试图挣脱出来，把你的人生卷进一场未竟野心与碎心苦痛的巨大风暴里。

lines.en: So it goes, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概就是这么回事吧。

lines.en: : So, out of the three swimsuits I actually tried on today before we got {i}distracted,{/i} which one was your favorite?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天在我们被{i}分散注意力{/i}之前，我真正试穿的那三件泳衣里，你最喜欢哪一件？

lines.en: : I don’t remember any of them, to be completely honest. I knew they were only a front.
lines.zh: : 说实话我一件都不记得了。我知道那只是个幌子。

lines.en: : You like my regular one too much for me to buy a new one anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正你也太喜欢我平时那件了，我不会买新的。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad29

: Oh! That reminds me, though. You remember Geoffrey, obviously. Well, {i}apparently,{/i} he designed that entire {i}line{/i} of swimwear. And he did it while blindfolded by the Spetsnaz. Crazy, right?
lines.zh: : 哦！不过这提醒我了。Geoffrey 你肯定记得吧。嗯，{i}据说{/i}那一整条泳装{i}线{/i}都是他设计的。而且他是在被 Spetsnaz 蒙着眼睛的情况下设计的。疯了吧？

lines.en: : So he’s a fashion designer too, now?
lines.zh: : 那他现在也是服装设计师了？

lines.en: : Not anymore. He did all of that under duress and has sworn off the craft since then.
lines.zh: : 不再是了。他是在胁迫下做完那一切的，从那以后就发誓再也不碰这行了。

lines.en: : I think I could get him to go back into it if I wanted to. I just don’t want to bring back any bad memories, you know?
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要我想，我能让他重操旧业。我只是不想勾起什么不好的回忆，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Like, I’d have to be a real {i}jerk{/i} to intentionally go out of my way and do something like that when everything was fine and normal a second ago. Wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 就是说，在一切明明刚才还好好的、很正常的这个时候，我要是特意绕远路去做那种事，那我得是个多大的{i}混蛋{/i}啊。你说是吧？

lines.en: : Is this you subtly voicing your displeasure with me for inviting Kirin again?
lines.zh: : 这是你在隐晦地表达对我又把 Kirin 叫上的不满吗？

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad30
: Well, it’s not so subtle anymore now, is it?
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在就不怎么隐晦了，对吧？

lines.en: : Heh...hahah...
scene black
scene kirinmallsad31
: What? What are {i}you{/i} laughing at?
lines.zh: : 什么？{i}你{/i}在笑什么？

lines.en: : Just...you guys.
lines.zh: : 就是……你们俩。

lines.en: : You look so good together...
lines.zh: : 你们看起来好般配……

lines.en: : Like you’re really made for each other. It’s sweet.
lines.zh: : 就像真的是为彼此而生的一样。很甜。

lines.en: : Great job, Ayane. Your constant passive-aggressiveness has made her look even {i}more{/i} sad.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Ayane。你持续不断的阴阳怪气让她看起来{i}更{/i}伤心了。

lines.en: : No it hasn’t. Those are tears of joy.
lines.zh: : 没有。那是喜悦的泪水。

lines.en: : {size=-2}She’s accepted that no amount of meddling in our affairs can ever destroy us and, in a moment similar to what happens in “How the Grinch Stole Christmas,” her heart has grown three sizes and finally brought her bliss.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}她已经接受了：无论怎么插手我们的事都摧毁不了我们，而且在一个类似于《圣诞怪杰》里的时刻，她的心胀大了三倍，终于得到了极乐。{/size}

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, you are right. And that my attitude has reinforced her belief that she is nothing more than a third wheel today and that we’d be just fine without her here. If not better.
lines.zh: : 或者另一种可能，你是对的。而我的态度强化了她的想法，让她觉得自己今天不过是个多余的第三者，没有她在这儿我们会过得很好。甚至更好。

lines.en: : Again, you’re not wrong.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你没说错。

lines.en: : And again, I would like you to stop agreeing with me.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我希望你别再同意我了。

lines.en: : Stop being so perfect all the time and I won’t have to.
lines.zh: : 别总是那么完美，我就不用同意了。

lines.en: : Do you really think that complimenting me and going along with everything I say is going to make me look at you as anything more than a parasite? Because it won’t.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得恭维我、我说什么你都应着，就能让我把你当成寄生虫以外的什么东西吗？不可能的。

lines.en: : Ayane, stop. She gets it.
lines.zh: : Ayane，够了。她已经懂了。

lines.en: : No, I don’t get it. Keep going. Tear me apart.
lines.zh: : 不，我不懂。继续。把我撕碎。

lines.en: : Strangle me again if you have to. Let’s hear it, Ayane. All of it.
lines.zh: : 有必要的话再掐我一次。说吧，Ayane。全都说出来。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’d like that wouldn’t you? What a foreign sensation it must be — having someone touch you of their own free will instead of you quite literally forcing their hand.
lines.zh: : 对啊，你肯定会喜欢吧？那感觉一定很陌生——有人出于自愿碰你，而不是你硬逼着人家伸手。

lines.en: : Mhm...Everything I do is to just...force myself into somewhere I’ve never belonged. You’re so right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我做的一切，都只是为了……硬挤进一个我从来就不属于的地方。你说得太对了。

lines.en: : Is that sarcasm?
lines.zh: : 这是在讽刺吗？

lines.en: : No. You’re right. You’re literally right. No one in their right mind would ever pick me over someone like you.
lines.zh: : 不是。你是对的。你就是字面意义上的对。任何脑子正常的人都绝不会选我而不选你这样的人。

lines.en: : So pretty. And kind. To {i}most{/i} people at least. Loyal. That ability to switch between mature and quirky whenever you want. Your body. Your sense of humor. You don’t have a single fucking flaw, do you?
lines.zh: : 又漂亮。又善良。至少对{i}大部分{/i}人来说。又忠诚。那种成熟和古灵精怪随时切换的能力。你的身体。你的幽默感。你他妈一个缺点都没有，是吧？

lines.en: : You and Karin both. Noriko too. Like fucking every single person I know is better than me at literally everything and so I went after the most perfect one of all to try and feel better about myself. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 你和 Karin 都是。Noriko 也是。好像我认识的每一个人都他妈在每一件事上都比我强，所以我才去追最完美的那一个，想让自己好受点。对不起。

lines.en: : You’re not {i}sorry.{/i} You’re just upset that you can’t leech your way to the top.
lines.zh: : 你才不{i}抱歉{/i}。你只是因为没法靠寄生爬到顶上而不爽。

lines.en: : No, I’m sorry. I’m {i}really{/i} fucking sorry. I admire you so much...and I really hope you two are happy together one day.
lines.zh: : 不，我很抱歉。我{i}真的{/i}他妈很抱歉。我好崇拜你……我真的希望你们俩有一天能幸福。

lines.en: : You’re going to be a great mom, Ayane. I just know it.
lines.zh: : 你会是个很棒的妈妈的，Ayane。我就是知道。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad32
: Way better than mine. Way better than {i}yours.{/i}
lines.zh: : 比我的强多了。比{i}你的{/i}强多了。

lines.en: : Better than anyone’s. And your kids are going to grow up to change the world and mine are just...hah, who am I kidding? I’ll never be a {i}mom.{/i} No one’s going to have kids with {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: : 比任何人的都强。而你的孩子长大后会改变世界，我的孩子却只是……哈，我在跟谁开玩笑？我永远当不了{i}妈妈{/i}。没人会跟{i}我{/i}生孩子！

lines.en: : No one’s ever going to want {i}me!{/i} Not for {i}long{/i} at least! I’m just a quick fix you can drag into a fucking bathroom to have your way with and then never think about again! I’ll never be a {i}princess!{/i} But {i}you{/i} will!
lines.zh: : 永远没有人会想要{i}我{/i}！至少不会想要{i}很久{/i}！我不过是个速效的解药，你可以把我拖进他妈的洗手间里发泄完，然后永远不再想起！我永远当不了{i}公主{/i}！但{i}你{/i}会！

lines.en: : You’ll be anything and everything you want to be...and I am so...{i}so{/i} sorry...for wanting a taste of that.
lines.zh: : 你会成为你想成为的一切……而我真的、{i}真的{/i}好抱歉……因为我想要尝一口那个味道。

lines.en: : Kirin.
lines.zh: : Kirin。

lines.en: : No, not just {i}wanting{/i} it! I grabbed the whole fucking spoon and shoved it all down my throat because it was the only way I’d ever know what it’s like to be anywhere {i}close{/i} to you!
lines.zh: : 不，不只是{i}想要{/i}！我他妈抓起整把勺子全塞进了自己喉咙里，因为那是唯一能让我知道离你{i}近{/i}一点是什么感觉的方法！

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I’m sorry! And I know don’t deserve your forgiveness, but I want it! Just...don’t give it to me! I don’t want to be responsible for devaluing you any more than I already have!
lines.zh: : 对不起……对不起！我知道我不配得到你的原谅，可我想要！只是……别给我！我不想再为贬低你而负责，我已经贬低得够多了！

lines.en: : Kirin, what are-
lines.zh: : Kirin，你在做什——

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad33
: Please...never forgive me!
lines.zh: : 求你了……永远别原谅我！

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad34

: I don’t deserve to sit at the same table or breathe the same air or even walk on the same floor as you! I am a waste of a child and a waste of a friend and a waste of a {i}person{/i} who is not fit to love or be loved!
lines.zh: : 我不配和你坐在同一张桌子旁，不配和你呼吸同样的空气，甚至不配和你走在同一层地板上！我是个废物孩子、废物朋友、废物{i}人{/i}，根本不配去爱，也不配被爱！

lines.en: : {size=-2}I’m sorry Sensei invited me along and I’m sorry I came and I’m sorry I’m only making your day worse by being here but I don’t know what I’m doing and I’m just so sorry, Ayane! I’m so sorry! I don’t know what else to say!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我很抱歉老师叫上我，我很抱歉我来了，我很抱歉我在这儿只会让你这一天更糟，可我不知道自己在做什么，我就是很抱歉，Ayane！我很抱歉！我不知道还能说什么了！{/size}

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. You don’t have to say anything. But you definitely don’t have to dogeza either, so-
lines.zh: : 呃……好啦。你不用说什么。但你肯定也不用土下座，所以——

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad35

: OF COURSE I FUCKING DO! Just because I don’t want your forgiveness doesn’t mean I don’t want to ask for it! The least you can know is how fucking sorry I am since I’ve never properly gotten it across!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然要！我不想让你原谅，不代表我不想请求你原谅！至少你该知道我他妈有多抱歉，因为我从来没有好好表达过！

lines.en: : And even now, begging on the floor like this is merely a fraction of what you deserve! I just don’t know what else I {i}can{/i} do without a fucking wakizashi!
lines.zh: : 就算现在像这样趴在地上乞求，也只是你应得的万分之一！没有一把他妈的胁差，我真不知道自己还{i}能{/i}做什么！

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad36
: New idea! Let’s just calm down and {i}not{/i} bring seppuku into the equation? Sound good?!
lines.zh: : 新想法！我们冷静一下，{i}别{/i}把切腹扯进来？好不好？！

lines.en: : No! No, Ayane! It doesn’t fucking sound good! I’d rather die and have you know I’m sorry than live with you thinking I am proud of myself for what I did to you when I’m {i}not!{/i}
lines.zh: : 不！不，Ayane！这一点儿都不他妈的好！我宁愿死，也要让你知道我很抱歉，也不想活着让你以为我为自己对你做过的事感到骄傲，可我{i}没有{/i}！

lines.en: : It haunts me every night now! Just thinking about it makes me want to puke! And all those things I said and did after only made it worse!
lines.zh: : 现在每天晚上它都缠着我！光是想一想就想吐！而我之后说的那些话、做的那些事，只让事情变得更糟！

lines.en: : You can kill me yourself if it makes you happy! Just make sure I’m fucking dead because I’m an idiot who’s probably going to make the same mistakes again and ruin someone {i}else’s{/i} life next!
lines.zh: : 如果那样能让你开心，你可以亲手杀了我！只要确保我他妈死透就行，因为我是个蠢货，大概还会再犯同样的错，去毁掉{i}下一个{/i}人的生活！

lines.en: : I might hate you, but I don’t actually want you to {i}die!{/i} Nor do I think you {i}should!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也许是恨你，但我真的不想让你{i}死{/i}！我也不觉得你{i}该{/i}死！

lines.en: : Then how the fuck am I supposed to repent?! What can I do to make myself feel like I deserve to be here?! What did {i}you{/i} do after I ruined your life?!
lines.zh: : 那我他妈该怎么赎罪？！我要做什么才能让{i}自己{/i}觉得配站在这里？！在我毁了你的人生之后，你做了什么？！

lines.en: : How are you still so confident?! Why are you not broken?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么还能这么自信？！你为什么没有崩溃？！

lines.en: : Kirin, for the love of God, if you don’t want me to hate you any {i}more,{/i} you will stop making a scene right now. This is only making things worse.
lines.zh: : Kirin，看在上帝的份上，如果你不想让我{i}更{/i}恨你，你现在就别再闹了。这只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad37
: Everything I do makes everything worse, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我做的每一件事都让一切变得更糟，Ayane……

lines.en: : How can I be someone like you?...
lines.zh: : 我怎么才能变成像你一样的人？……

lines.en: : How can I stop always doing the opposite of what I {i}want?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我怎么才能不再总是做出和自己{i}想{/i}要的相反的事？

lines.en: : How do you do it?...How are you so fucking amazing?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么做到的？……你怎么能这么他妈了不起？

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad38
: Kirin, I’m not.
lines.zh: : Kirin，我并不了不起。

lines.en: : And the way I’ve been treating you today despite knowing you were going through something like this is all the proof you need of that.
lines.zh: : 而今天明知你在经历这种事，我还那样对你，就是你需要的所有证据。

lines.en: : No one is perfect. No one is as {i}amazing{/i} as you think I am. And the advice I have here is going to sound harsh, but it’s the only advice I have when it comes to things like this.
lines.zh: : 没有人是完美的。没有人像你以为的我这么{i}了不起{/i}。而我在这方面的建议听起来会很刺耳，但遇到这种事，我只有这一个建议。

lines.en: : If you want to stop doing the opposite of what you {i}really{/i} want, then just {i}fucking stop.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你想不再做出和你{i}真正{/i}想要的相反的事，那就{i}他妈停下来{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know why you make things harder for yourself. I assumed you just got a rise out of it. But if you hate it so much, {i}stop.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道你为什么要把事情搞得这么难。我原以为你就是从中找乐子。但如果你这么讨厌它，那就{i}别做了{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s it. That’s all I have. I’m just a girl like you. I’m not an angel.
lines.zh: : 就这样。我就只有这些。我和你一样只是个女孩。我不是天使。

lines.en: : What if I can’t, though?...
lines.zh: : 可如果我做不到呢？……

lines.en: : I’ve been trying to be good...but no one thinks I can. So I stop trying at all...
lines.zh: : 我一直在努力变好……但没人觉得我可以。所以我就彻底不努力了……

lines.en: : I don’t know what else is left for me...I don’t know where to go from here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还剩下什么给我……我不知道接下来该往哪儿走。

lines.en: : Then start from phase one and pick yourself up off of the floor. Okay? Neither one of us belongs down here.
lines.zh: : 那就从第一阶段开始，把自己从地上扶起来。好吗？我们俩谁都不属于这地上。

lines.en: : How can you say that about me?...After all I’ve done?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能对我说出这种话？……在我做了那么多之后？

lines.en: : Because {i}no one{/i} belongs down here. That’s how.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}没有人{/i}属于这地上。就是这样。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry, Ayane. I will do {i}anything{/i} to show you. {i}Anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我真的很抱歉，Ayane。我愿意做{i}任何事{/i}来向你证明。{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: : Then just eat your fucking parfait and smile like a normal girl. Okay?
lines.zh: : 那就把他妈的芭菲吃掉，像个正常女孩一样笑一笑。好吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really hungry, but okay. If that’s what you want...
lines.zh: : 我不太饿，但是好。如果你想这样的话……

lines.en: scene kirinmallsad39
: Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师——

lines.en: : My lips are sealed and I am fully prepared to never again acknowledge anything that has happened over the last five minutes.
lines.zh: : 我的嘴很严，而且我已经做好了充分的准备，永远不再承认过去五分钟里发生的任何事。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...really...
lines.zh: : 对不起……真的……

lines.en: : Things lately are just...
lines.zh: : 最近的事情就是……

lines.en: scene black
: Don’t worry about it. Just...here. Parfait. Eat.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。来……接着。芭菲。吃吧。

lines.en: : Mmh...
The three of us have a great time and no one has any sort of mental breakdown at all.
lines.zh: 我们三个人玩得很开心，谁都没有任何形式的精神崩溃。

lines.en: Kirin leaves early and Ayane and I decide to head out shortly after.
lines.zh: Kirin 提前走了，Ayane 和我决定不一会儿也出发。

lines.en: My relationship with each of them slightly improves.
lines.zh: 我和她们各自的关系都略微改善了。
